items.title: How Will Air Products and Chemicals Stock React To Its Upcoming Earnings?
items.summary: Air Products and Chemicals (NYSE: APD) will discuss its fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter results on a conference call on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The company has a market value of about $70.4 billion. Over the last twelve months, it generated $12.6 billion in revenue and $3.1 billion in operating profit before charges for business and asset actions. After those charges, it posted a net loss of $47 million.

items.title: Valero to Acquire Houston Refining Site, Plans 165,000 BPD Restart
items.summary: VLO's $320.5M Houston refining site acquisition is expected to expand its refining operations, with plans to restart 165,000 BPD of light crude capacity by 2027.

items.title: LyondellBasell to Sell Former Houston Refinery Site for $320.5M
items.summary: LYB's $320.5M Houston refinery site sale to Valero advances its portfolio transformation, streamlines operations and supports long-term value creation.

items.title: LyondellBasell (LYB) Stock Rallies On Q3 Earnings And Cash Strength
items.summary: LyondellBasell came into this Q3 2026 report with a stock that had already been rebuilding confidence over the past month; then the latest numbers lit a fresh spark. The share price jumped 5% to US$68.64 on the first full trading day after earnings, as investors reacted to a quarter anchored by US$2.38 in basic earnings per share and US$8.5b in revenue. items.title: LyondellBasell's Dividend Looks Safer, But a New Risk Could Change That
items.summary: LyondellBasell cut its dividend to 69 cents per share, but Q3 cash flow shows it's well covered, even as unconfirmed reports of a $14 billion Shell asset acquisition raise debt concerns.

items.title: LyondellBasell Industries (LYB) Returns To Profit And Sells Houston Site, Is It Fully Priced?
items.summary: LyondellBasell Industries (NYSE:LYB) is back in focus after its third quarter 2026 update, which paired a return to profit with an asset sale that reshapes the business footprint.
